scope: Fusion conversion of each prepared stencil variant: TSM import into a new Form, conversion, save to the ignored tmp folder

api.addByShapeInput:
Creates a new T-Spline body of the shape specified by the input.
input : One of the various types of TSpline shape inputs that define all of the parameters needed to create a T-Spline
body of that shape. The input objects are created using the various create methods on the TSplineBodies object.
Returns the new TSplineBody or null in the case of an error.
api.addByTSMDescription:
Creates a new TSplineBody using the T-Spline description provided by the input
string which contains TSM formatted text.
tsmDescription : A string that contains a T-Spline description in TSM form.
Returns the newly created TSplineBody if successful or null in the case of failure.
api.addByTSMFile:
Creates a new TSplineBody by reading in a TSM file from disk.
tsmFilename : The full filename of the TSM file on disk.
Returns the newly created TSplineBody if successful or null in the case of failure.
api.createBoxInput:
Creates a TSplineBoxInput object that is used to define all of the input required to create a box shaped
T-Spline body. The fully defined TSplineBoxInput object is passed into the add method to create the
actual T-Spline body. The origin, xDirection, and yDirection define a coordinate system in space where length
is x, width is y, and height is z. X and Y directions are explicitly defined using arguments and Z is derived
by using the right-hand rule and crossing X into the Y direction.
Additional settings can be defined using the returned TSplineBoxInput object.
origin : The corner point of the box. The xSize, ySize and zSize are measured from this point in the X, Y and Z directions.
xDirection : A vector defining the X direction.
yDirection : A vector defining the Y direction. This should be perpendicular to the xDirection.
xSize : The size of the box in the X direction in centimeters.
ySize : The size of the box in the Y direction in centimeters.
zSize : The size of the box in the Z direction in centimeters.
Returns the newly created TSplineBoxInput object or null if the creation failed.
api.createCylinderInput:
Creates a TSplineCylinderInput object that is used to define all of the input required to create a cylinder shaped
T-Spline body. The fully defined TSplineCylinderInput object is passed into the add method to create the
actual T-Spline body. The origin, xDirection, and yDirection define a coordinate system in space where the axis of the cylinder is in the Z direction.
Additional settings can be defined using the returned TSplineCylinderInput object.
origin : The center point of the base of the cylinder.
xDirection : A vector defining the X direction.
yDirection : A vector defining the Y direction. This should be perpendicular to the xDirection.
radius : The radius of the cylinder in centimeters.
height : The height of the cylinder in the Z direction in centimeters.
Returns the newly created TSplineCylinderInput object or null if the creation failed.

is x, width is y.
Additional settings can be defined using the returned TSplinePlaneInput object.
origin : The corner point of the plane. The xSize and ySize are measured from this point in the X and Y directions.
xDirection : A vector defining the X direction.
yDirection : A vector defining the Y direction. This should be perpendicular to the xDirection.
xSize : The size of the plane in the X direction in centimeters.
ySize : The size of the plane in the Y direction in centimeters.
Returns the newly created TSplinePlaneInput object or null if the creation failed.

Additional settings can be defined using the returned TSplineQuadballInput object.
origin : The center point of the quadball.
xDirection : A vector defining the X direction.
yDirection : A vector defining the Y direction. This should be perpendicular to the xDirection.
radius : The radius of the quadball in centimeters.
Returns the newly created TSplineQuadballInput object or null if the creation failed.
